description: KNaH₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. K is bonded to six H atoms to form KH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KH₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent KH₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.67 Å) and four longer (2.68 Å) K-H bond lengths. Na is bonded to six H atoms to form NaH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaH₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaH₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent KH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.67 Å) and four longer (2.68 Å) Na-H bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing HK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second H site, H is bonded to two equivalent K and four equivalent Na atoms to form HK₂Na₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HK₂Na₄ octahedra and edges with twelve HK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
